test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

John bought sweets at the store when he visited yesterday.

options.text: Sweets were to be bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday.
Sweets were bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday.
Sweets were being bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday.
Sweets are bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "John bought sweets at the store when he visited yesterday" can be passivized to "Sweets were bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday."
 
• In this passive sentence, the action (buys sweets) is more important than the doer (John).
 
• The past simple verb form (bought) changes to "were bought" in the passive voice.
 
• Therefore, the corrected sentence is "Sweets were bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday."

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ("Sweets were to be bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday") suggests a future event which hasn't taken place at the time of the visit, which is not what the original sentence intended.
 
• Option 3 ("Sweets were being bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday.") incorrectly uses past continuous form.
 
• Option 4 ("Sweets are bought by John at the store when he visited yesterday.") incorrectly uses present form.
